title: Add audit log export to S3 for compliance
description: Compliance needs a nightly export of the audit_log table to an S3 bucket in a format they can query with Athena. Must not expose PII fields that aren't required for the compliance use case.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Wrote a management command run via a scheduled ECS task rather than a Lambda, since the export needs the full Django ORM and app settings and the job can take a few minutes for large date ranges.

comments.author: compliance-lead
comments.text: Please confirm the export excludes raw card details and free-text customer notes fields.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Confirmed, export uses an explicit allow-list of columns rather than a blanket dump of the table.

implementation_notes: Export command selects an explicit column allow-list, writes partitioned Parquet files by date, and uploads to S3 via boto3 with server-side encryption enabled. Scheduled via an ECS Fargate task triggered by EventBridge on a daily cron.
resolution: Deployed and verified against a week of production data with Athena queries from the compliance team. No PII fields outside the allow-list are present in the export.
